cells.value: friction between the air and the body
cells.quote: If we think of drag as being caused by friction between the air and the body, a logical choice would be the total surface area of the body.

cells.value: any area that can be easily measured
cells.quote: we are free to use any area that can be easily measured.
a resistance to the flow, a more logical choice would be the frontal area

cells.value: related by the ratio of the areas
cells.quote: But the drag is the same, and the coefficients are related by the ratio of the areas.
And finally, if we want to compare with the lift coefficient, we should use the same wing area used to derive the lift coefficient.

cells.value: computed coefficient will have a different value
cells.quote: If we choose the wing area, rather than the cross-sectional area, the computed coefficient will have a different value.
